as_hint: How the team's assistant and the site's assistant work: model, limits, instructions, skills.
as_lead: A field left empty inherits the platform's value (shown faintly in the field). The platform's limits cannot be passed.
as_readonly: You can see the settings; only the Owner or an Admin can change them.
as_f_messages_perDay: Messages per day (per person or visitor)
as_f_budget_hardStop: Stop when the budget is spent
as_f_booking_horizonDays: How many days ahead times are offered
as_f_handoff_enabled: Offer a person when it cannot help
as_f_memory_historyMessages: Messages of the conversation read back
as_f_logging_redactPii: Hide personal data from the logs
as_booking_fixed: The name, a phone or an e-mail, for whom the visit is, consent and the time (or a call back) are always asked for and cannot be switched off.
as_skills_hint: Instruction packs the assistant follows when one of their words appears. They can limit the tools used.
as_s_triggers: Words that start it (comma separated; empty = always)
as_s_tools: Only these tools or actions (comma separated; empty = all allowed)
as_roles_hint: For the team's assistant: who has it and with what limits. A person with several roles gets the most generous value.
as_problem_invalid: A value passes the platform's limit or is not valid. Nothing was saved.
as_problem_conflict: Someone else saved meanwhile. Reload the page and try again.
as_pl_lead: The defaults of every organisation and the limits they cannot pass.
as_pl_open: The assistant's settings for the whole platform
as_c_forceRedaction: Personal data is always hidden from the logs
